snippet.title: Stay Home FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Stay Home By Hikaru, ihasllamas Ending: Happy ending 2D Indie Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Stay home and prepare for an important event! Take control of a young scavenger named June and retrieve items scattered throughout her home needed for the party with her cute companion, Peanut!  Just focus on the party and everything will be okay.

Stay Home: https://hikarui.itch.io/stay-home
Developer: Hikaru, ihasllamas
Genres: RPG, Story Rich
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
